method: Notion MCP create_pages twice with identical AppEntityId, then SQL query_data_sources
conclusion: Notion Data Source accepts multiple pages with the same AppEntityId. Without Gateway LWW (query-before-create + ambiguous_race refuse), concurrent creates produce duplicate pages. MVP guarantee: best-effort LWW within one Worker request; duplicateCount>1 returns conflict reason=ambiguous_race and does NOT silently create/overwrite. Strong consistency across isolates is NOT promised (O5).
gatewayBehavior: decidePushOp duplicateCount>1 → conflict ambiguous_race; unit test tests/lww.test.ts covers this
